data.description:
## Problem
The /dso:respond-to-pr-comments skill, when classifying a PR comment as 'defer', creates a follow-up ticket with title 'PR comment deferred:' and either an empty description or a 66-char placeholder ('Agreed, we should track this separately.'). The ticket has no parent epic linking it back to the PR context or the originating story.

## Evidence
8 such orphan stubs found in the 2026-05-12 audit, now deleted: 02be-0152, 1364-c4d6, 397b-8326, 5a01-f2bc, 65a1-554b, 7604-7ffd, d42b-5cc0, d5bf-e82e. All had descriptions <= 66 chars and 0 comments.

## Expected behavior
Deferred-comment tickets should carry:
- The PR URL and comment ID in the description.
- The original commenter's text.
- A parent link to the story/epic the PR was implementing (derivable from the PR's DSO-Story trailer).
- Sufficient context that a future agent can act on the ticket without consulting the PR.

## Repro
Run /dso:respond-to-pr-comments against any PR with a deferrable comment, observe the created ticket. Skill: plugins/dso/skills/respond-to-pr-comments/SKILL.md.
data.title: [respond-to-pr-comments]: 'PR comment deferred' tickets created with empty body and no parent epic -> 8 orphan stubs in tracker
